latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – complete, standalone web performance auditing and optimization framework.

- Provides a tiered web performance audit checklist covering all Core Web Vitals and key resource metrics.
- Features diagnosis guides: waterfall analysis, bottleneck decision tree, and resource impact scoring system.
- Includes actionable, detailed playbooks for server, resource, JavaScript, and layout optimization.
- Offers templates for audit reporting, cache headers, and performance-critical resource handling.
- Supports tool-assisted and fully manual workflows—integrates with Lighthouse, WebPageTest, or plain browser inspection.
